name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to mid-chest, then press to lockout without bouncing.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until arms are extended, then lower under control.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set both pulleys high and hold a handle in each hand, one foot forward.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging arc, then return slowly.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, holding the bar at arms length.
Pull the bar to your lower ribcage, squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower.

name: Wide Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pads, grip the bar wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with the elbows, then return under control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet on the platform and a slight bend in the knees, back straight.
Pull the handle to your abdomen, squeezing the shoulder blades, then extend the arms.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit down and back until thighs are at least parallel, then drive up through mid-foot.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower the platform until knees reach about 90 degrees, then press back without locking out hard.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower shins and knees aligned with the pivot.
Extend the knees until legs are straight, pause, then lower under control.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height, soft knees, shoulders back.
Push the hips back and lower the bar along your thighs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand tall.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad against your lower calves.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, barbell across the hips, feet flat.
Drive through the heels to lift the hips until the torso is parallel to the floor, squeeze, then lower.

name: Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the bar at collarbone height, elbows slightly in front, core braced.
Press overhead until arms lock, moving the head back then through, then lower to the start.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, slight elbow bend.
Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height, leading with the elbows, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding the bar at shoulder width, elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar to shoulder height without swinging, then lower under control.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell, rotating the palm up as you lift, then lower and alternate.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Face a high pulley with a straight or rope attachment, elbows pinned to your sides.
Extend the arms fully down, squeeze the triceps, then return to 90 degrees.

name: Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ or straight bar over your forehead, upper arms vertical.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar near your hairline, then extend back up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform, shoulders under the pads.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible, pause, then lower until you feel a stretch.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley, holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch down by flexing the spine and bringing your elbows toward your thighs, then return slowly.
